description: New text for a comment, or for one of its replies with reply_id. Drive lets an account edit only what it wrote.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

file_id.description: The file's id, or its URL.

reply_id.description: A reply's id, to edit the reply rather than the comment.

name: edit_comment
title: Edit a comment or reply
